name: arhun-plugins
description: Arhun Saday's Claude Code plugins: mods, skills, commands, agents and hooks.

plugins.name: assumptions
plugins.description: Lists the small guesses Claude made without asking; mark each right or wrong, and a wrong one gets fixed on its own

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Holds destructive commands (rm -r, force pushes, git resets and cleans, branch deletes, migrations, SQL drops) and shows what they would destroy

plugins.name: bureau
plugins.description: Le Bureau des agents in a side pane: its pixel-art office and engine, playing your session

plugins.name: cache-warm
plugins.description: Prompt-cache warmth above the prompt: countdown, hit rate, savings, lapse warnings and keep-warm pings, toggled by /cache-warm

plugins.name: context-cache
plugins.description: Context usage, usage limits and prompt-cache warmth above the prompt, drawn in your theme; collapses to one line

plugins.name: decision-log
plugins.description: Spots decisions in your prompts (French and English cues like "on part sur", "we'll go with") and appends them to DECISIONS.md with the date; a band shows the last one and /decision-log lists them.

plugins.name: plan-progress
plugins.description: Live plan progress bars above the Claude Code prompt: stages, steps, foldable agent strips and soft sounds

plugins.name: preflight
plugins.description: Lets Claude drive the Preflight CLI: audit your AI setup (doctor, context cost), install resources and loadouts with a dry run first, and share or import a setup.

plugins.name: secret-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Write, Edit and Bash calls that would put API keys, tokens, private keys or .env contents on disk or on the network, with a masked preview and an allow-once button.

plugins.name: spend-meter
plugins.description: Session and per-turn cost above the prompt with a budget bar, a toast at 80% and a confirmation before the next prompt at 100%; collapses to one line

plugins.name: where-am-i
plugins.description: A live recap above the prompt: goal, what Claude is doing now, next step and what waits on you
